summary.oneLiner: Duroply reported modest Q4 revenue growth (+5% YoY) with EBITDA margins compressing to 5.18% due to elevated petrochemical input costs and wage code adjustments, though annual EBITDA grew 25% driven by working capital efficiency. Management targets a return to low-to-mid double-digit volume growth in FY27, betting on market share gains from unorganized players despite persistent inflationary headwinds from West Asia tensions.

one-line thesis: Duroply reported modest Q4 revenue growth (+5% YoY) with EBITDA margins compressing to 5.18% due to elevated petrochemical input costs and wage code adjustments, though annual EBITDA grew 25% driven by working capital efficiency. Management targets a return to low-to-mid double-digit volume growth in FY27, betting on market share gains from unorganized players despite persistent inflationary headwinds from West Asia tensions.
financial scorecard: Revenue: INR 111.6 Cr (+5% YoY, +20% QoQ); EBITDA: INR 5.18 Cr (Margin ~4.6%, down from 5.4 Cr in Q4FY25); PAT: Not explicitly stated, PBT INR 1.03 Cr includes INR 0.275 Cr one-time loss (wage code); Order Book: Not disclosed (B2B focus emerging); Net Debt: Not disclosed, but working capital improved (Debtor days 42 vs 47, Inventory 146 vs 169).
guidance: Revenue Growth: 9-12% quantitative growth (volumetric 10-12% + price); Margin: Aiming for expansion from current ~5.5% level despite cost pressures; Order Inflow: Focus on new B2B/project segment; Capex/Commissioning: No specific capex guidance, focus on sales force expansion.
order book & pipeline: Not explicitly quantified; strategic shift towards B2B and project sales initiated in FY27 after previously focusing on retail.
segment / subsidiary detail: In-house manufacturing revenue INR 61.9 Cr (+4% YoY); Contract manufacturing revenue INR 49.7 Cr (+6.7% YoY, +50% QoQ). Full year in-house INR 224.9 Cr (+2.3%); Contract INR 177.7 Cr (+17%).
growth verticals / optionality: Shift from unorganized to organized sector due to supply chain disruptions; new focus on B2B/project sales channel; expansion of frontline sales force; loyalty program restructuring.
margins & cost dynamics: Gross Margin 34.3% (down from 37% QoQ); Input costs (melamine, urea, phenol) elevated due to Gulf import dependency and USD depreciation; freight and labor costs rising; partial price hikes passed in Mar-Apr, facing resistance in May.
capex / expansion: No specific capex numbers provided; investments directed towards sales force expansion and working capital optimization rather than heavy manufacturing capacity addition.
capital allocation: Focus on working capital management (reduced debtor, inventory, and payable days); sufficient liquidity maintained for raw material procurement.
risks & watch-items: Geopolitical tension in West Asia affecting petrochemical imports; USD depreciation increasing import costs; inability to fully pass on inflation to consumers; high labor cost inflation; 70% industry still unorganized limiting pricing power.
management quality / tone: Cautiously optimistic; acknowledges short-term inflationary blips but maintains strong long-term (7-10 year) view; conservative on guidance due to geopolitical uncertainty; transparent about one-time wage code impacts.
non-obvious takeaways: Contract manufacturing grew 50% QoQ suggesting potential capacity constraints or strategic pivot in in-house production; significant reduction in payable days (117 to 72) indicates tighter supplier terms or early payments to secure supply amidst shortages.

themes.title: Building-materials & home-improvement up-cycle
themes.need: The residential up-cycle pulls a broad finishing/home-improvement basket - tiles & sanitaryware (KAJARIACER/CERA/SOMANYCERA/ORIENTBELL/HINDWAREAP), wood-panels & laminates (CENTURYPLY/GREENPANEL/GREENLAM/RUSHIL/STYLAMIND), pipes/adhesives (PIDILITIND/SUPREMEIND/ASTRAL-tier) and paints (ASIANPAINT/CARYSIL/SIRCA). Premiumization + GST formalization shift share to organized players.
themes.driver: Festive/real-estate completion demand; GST 2.0 + commodity tailwinds; capacity commissioning and channel restocking.
